choices.prompt: After those counts — which picture do you lean on for now?
choices.notes: M3.2 §B choice-model-push. Wrong push → one-line pushback; does not soft-lock Hard.

options.label: Keep the plum-pudding picture — positive electricity spread through the atom.
options.softEffect: Watson/Rutherford one-line pushback on large-angle rarity; Hard still open.

consequenceLines.speaker: 华生
consequenceLines.text: If the positive electricity is smeared through the whole volume, those rare large-angle flashes are awkward — scarce, yes, but still on the screen. Can the diffuse sphere really throw a few paths that far?

consequenceLines.speaker: 卢瑟福
consequenceLines.text: Scarce is not none. Geiger and Marsden counted that class of event; I will not let a neat plum-pudding slogan brush them aside. We may still speak carefully — but not as if the large angles were a trifle.

options.label: Try the working hypothesis — a concentrated central charge.
options.softEffect: Cautious affirm; still not a closed case; lexicon prefers central charge.

consequenceLines.speaker: 卢瑟福
consequenceLines.text: Then take it as a working hypothesis: positive electricity gathered in a very small region at the centre. Most paths barely turn; a few turn hard. That is an account to press against the foil — not a verdict spoken as if the case were closed.

choices.prompt: That fifteen-inch shell striking tissue paper — how shall we treat it?
choices.notes: M3.2 §B choice-shell-metaphor. Accept-as-fact → interpretation warning; reject → cleaner lexicon.

options.label: Treat it as what happened in the dark room.
options.softEffect: InterpretationBadge / lodge tag warning; Watson corrects late recollection.

consequenceLines.speaker: 华生
consequenceLines.text: Careful — that shell-and-tissue picture is a later story. It is not a line from the nineteen-nine dark-room notebooks. Fine as a vivid later telling; dangerous if we file it as a lab fact.

consequenceLines.speaker: 旁白
consequenceLines.text: Marked as late recollection, not a Coupland dark-room quotation. Keep the shell metaphor off the evidence board as a primary cite.

options.label: Treat it as a later story — not a 1909 notebook line.

consequenceLines.speaker: 卢瑟福
consequenceLines.text: Keep to the screen and the notebook: diffuse reflection, foil, counts. Leave the shell picture for later storytellers.

choices.prompt: After this lodge review — back to the foil thickness on the bench?
choices.notes: M3.2 §B choice-return-bench. Yes → deep-link lab; No → stay city/lodge.

options.label: Yes — return to the apparatus and change the foil.
options.softEffect: Deep-link coupland-lab / labEmbed; resume foil-thickness check.

consequenceLines.speaker: 卢瑟福
consequenceLines.text: Then back to the bench. Change the foil thickness; watch whether the angular pattern shifts. Central charge stays a working hypothesis until the apparatus has another say.

claim.citation: M3.2 soft choice consequence — Coupland; not a Fact fill
claim.notes: Soft consequence only; does not soft-lock Hard.

consequenceLines.speaker: 华生
consequenceLines.text: Right — counts first, slogans later. Shall we try the foil again?

options.label: Not yet — stay with the city for now.
options.softEffect: Remain on city/lodge map; lab deep-link deferred.

consequenceLines.speaker: 华生
consequenceLines.text: Fair. We can keep observation and guess in separate piles a little longer — and come back to the foil when you are ready.

consequenceLines.text: The bench will wait. Coupland Street remains open; the foil check can resume from the laboratory node.
